stated_limitation: The place fields tile the whole track, with strong over-representation of the two reward ends (a well-documented feature of this dataset).

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1 (sub-Achilles) is the canonical SWR/replay dataset and session.
justification.handling: Real streaming via remfile, correct epochs, cell types, LFP channel, position, and an explicit running/place-cell selection.
justification.analysis: Standard ripple detection, Bayesian decoder validated on running data, and weighted-correlation replay with the required time-bin shuffle null, but the strengthening control of direction-split fields is absent.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (5548 ripples, 85/690=12.3%, 16 cm, 114 cells, 181 Hz, 47 ms) reproduces from the committed caches and is internally consistent and statistically robust (85 vs ~34.5 expected).
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the effect, and balance strongest-example panels with honest population summaries (e/f/g).
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and the modest 12% vs 5% fraction is reported plainly, but the write-up gives no explicit limitations (single session, end-biased fields limiting mid-track decoding) and mildly overstates 'smooth' sweeps that are largely end-to-end.
